title: A multicentre, retrospective study of perioperative mortality in anaesthesiology
summary:
Background: Between 1% and 4% of all patients undergoing surgery or a medical procedure die during their hospital stay, and the causes of these deaths may vary. 
Research question: What is the mortality rate during a hospital stay following surgery or a medical procedure carried out under anaesthetic care?
Methodology: Mortality rates are determined retrospectively over a calendar year across several hospitals. To this end, existing databases from hospital administration and anaesthesia departments are cross-referenced and analysed.
conditions: All medical conditions requiring surgery or a procedure in hospital under the care of an anaesthetist

interventions.name: A retrospective analysis of all patients who received anaesthetic care during the observation period as part of an operation or procedure.  The observation period covers one calendar year at a time. It begins in 2024 and is reset annually.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients who undergo surgery or a medical procedure during the observation year and receive anaesthetic care in the process. Annual analysis commencing in the calendar year 2024.
Exclusion criteria:
none
